title: docs: drop the remaining hand-kept indexes
body:
Removes the documentation indexes that are kept by hand. Every PR that adds a page was editing the same shared list, so branches in flight kept conflicting on files none of them were about: #470 hit it twice on `backlog/index.mdx`, and `architecture/decisions/index.mdx` changed 13 times in a week. The work queue is the tracker, and every listing is now generated. This follows general-knowledge `conventions/adr-pattern.md` ("No hand-kept index") and `feature-docs-as-memory.md` ("The generated index").

## What changes for you

- **Sidebar:** Desktop App, Backlog, Stack and Authentication now autogenerate from their folders, like every other section. Getting Started is the one fixed group. The Authentication landing page moves to `authentication/index.mdx`, and its URL is unchanged. Product Philosophy stays first in Desktop App through `sidebar.order` in its frontmatter. A new page appears when it is created. The manual lists had already drifted: 5 backlog pages and `desktop/analytics-and-flags` were not in the sidebar, and now they are.
- **ADRs:** the table in `architecture/decisions/index.mdx` is gone. The page keeps its intro and points to the generated sidebar, and each ADR file carries its own status and date. Existing links to `/architecture/decisions/` keep working.
- **Audit 2026-10-15 fix plans:** `00-index.md` loses its status line ("12 of 36 shipped") and its per-batch tables. What shipped is tracked in Linear (NIW2-381 to NIW2-422) and in the PRs that delete each plan. `report.md` points there.
- **Changelog:** `changelog.mdx` is deleted, together with its sidebar group. It was kept by hand and had been stale since 2026-07-01. The changelog template is removed from the `feature-docs` skill, and step 7 is removed from `/save-feature`, so no agent recreates it.
- **`.gitignore`:** now ignores `.build/`, the Swift Package Manager cache. It had slipped into this PR's first commit.
- **`CLAUDE.md`:** the Sidebar rule now says every folder autogenerates and that there are no hand-kept indexes.

Not touched:
- the two roadmaps (`backlog/roadmap.md`, `briefings/roadmap.md`), because the hub allows a roadmap as a promise;
- the section overview pages (`architecture/`, `testing/`, `marketing/` index), which are rarely edited;
- the feature-docs "Parent Index" template, which holds per-area context and is not a global list;
- old plans that mention `backlog/index.mdx`, which are history.

## Checks

- `bun run build` in `apps/documentation` succeeds (363 pages, one fewer because the changelog is gone).
- `oxfmt --check .` is clean, and the push hook's `verify-local` passed.

## How to test it yourself

1. Run `bun run dev` in `apps/documentation`.
2. Open the Backlog and Desktop App sidebar groups.
   - Expect: every page in each folder is listed, including `backlog/check-and-fix-files` and `desktop/analytics-and-flags`. There is no Changelog group.
3. Open `/architecture/decisions/`.
   - Expect: an intro with no table. The ADRs are in the sidebar.
4. Open `/plans/audit-2026-10-15/00-index/` and `/audits/2026-10-15/report/`.
   - Expect: no status counts. The links between them resolve.
